libraryScope: one persistent corpus per character/body variant
frameStorage: single transparent PNG file per frame
generationMode: one frame generated and persisted at a time

batchPackaging.mergeRule: unzipped batches merge into the persistent character corpus without replacing existing unique frames

hardRules: 50 frames is a generation batch, never the full library
every generated result is exactly one transparent PNG
every frame is persisted before the next generation job begins
completed batches may be zipped for storage or transfer
zipped batches must be recoverable and mergeable back into the corpus
character/body variants keep separate motion corpora
